name: ST NUCLEO-F446RE (Nucleo-64)
description: Faster F4 Nucleo-64: 180 MHz Cortex-M4F with 2 CAN, SAI/I2S and USB OTG on the Arduino Uno V3 + morpho headers, programmed through the built-in ST-LINK/V2-1.
notes: ST-LINK/V2-1 uses a Mini-B USB connector. CAN and USB OTG pins are only on the headers; no CAN transceiver or user USB connector is fitted.
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
